purpose: Independent CT-only repeat of released pose, not independent certification of original infrared-to-fine-CT placement
coarse_CT: reserved CT-only development and confirmation halo arrays
pose: Pinned ir_pose.json; no fit to ink, labels, models or IR photo
resampling: Independent scipy bilinear sampling with 4x4 subpixel area averaging through inverse released scale/rotation/translation; no OpenCV dependency
metrics: high-pass material normalized cross-correlation after Gaussian sigma3 coarse pixels
search: all 31 source CT planes; XY translations -32..32 coarse pixels inclusive, on the two fixed 256px cores with 64px halo
reported: expected plane26/zero-shift, best shift of plane26, and best plane/shift across all31; every search result retained
claim_limit: No binary gold-registration PASS from sourceflag or NCC alone; registration-dependent outcomes remain conditional until all transforms and uncertainty are resolved
